title: TiRex-2: Generalizing TiRex to Multivariate Data and Streaming
abstract: arXiv:2607.01204v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: We introduce TiRex-2, a recurrent xLSTM-based time series foundation model that generalizes the univariate TiRex to multivariate forecasting with both past and future covariates. Real-world forecasting is inherently sequential: observations arrive continuously, variables evolve jointly, and a subset of covariates is known ahead of time. Existing Transformer-based time series foundation models capture cross-variate dependencies, but the cost of ingesting each new observation grows at least linearly with context length, even with KV caching. TiRex-2 addresses these limitations with a memory-centric recurrent design built around an asymmetric group-attention variate mixer: paired with a bidirectional time mixer, it integrates future-known covariates while keeping target variables strictly causal. To our knowledge no other time series foundation model does both, and it is what makes streaming at constant per-patch cost possible. For scal

translated_title: TiRex-2：将 TiRex 推广至多变量数据与流式处理
translated_abstract: 我们提出了 TiRex-2，这是一个基于循环 xLSTM 的时间序列基础模型，它将单变量的 TiRex 推广到支持过去与未来协变量的多变量预测。现实世界的预测本质上是顺序性的：观测数据持续到达、多个变量共同演化，且其中一部分协变量是提前已知的。现有的基于 Transformer 的时间序列基础模型虽然能够捕获跨变量依赖关系，但即使使用了 KV 缓存，摄取每个新观测值的成本仍至少随上下文长度线性增长。TiRex-2 通过一种以记忆为中心的循环设计解决了这些局限，该设计围绕一个非对称组注意力变量混合器构建：与双向时间混合器相配合，它在保持目标变量严格因果性的同时，整合了未来已知的协变量。据我们所知，目前没有其他时间序列基础模型能同时做到这两点，而正是这一点使得以每个时间片段恒定成本进行流式预测成为可能。对于标量……（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: TiRex-2 是一个基于 xLSTM 的循环时间序列基础模型，通过非对称组注意力变量混合器与双向时间混合器的创新设计，首次同时实现了支持未来已知协变量的多变量预测与严格因果性保障，从而能够以每补丁恒定成本进行流式处理。
en_tdlr: TiRex-2 is a recurrent xLSTM-based time series foundation model that, via an asymmetric group-attention variate mixer paired with a bidirectional time mixer, is the first to simultaneously support multivariate forecasting with future-known covariates while preserving strict causality, enabling streaming at constant per-patch cost.
